name: Badge popping next to the head
description: A tilted orange pill badge bounces in beside the speaker's head at eye level: a white circle with an icon (a check that draws itself, an x, a star or a flame) and one big condensed uppercase word like 'EASY', then a glossy shine sweeps across it while it gently floats.
use_when: A one-word verdict or reaction the speaker says out loud: easy, done, fast, free, wrong, nope, winner, hot; a quick approval (check), rejection (x), highlight (star) or hype (fire).

text.help: one short word or two, e.g. 'EASY', 'DONE', 'NOPE'

icon.help: check | x | star | fire, or any icon name from docs/graphics.md

side.help: right | left: which side of the head it pops on
